admission.scope: Native registered Void closure only, RVA0x287640. ScriptAction::Execute itself immediately selects action behavior. Other return kinds have separate bridges; PlaySound Float handles Delay inside its own sound behavior.
admission.properties: Delay overrides DelaySeconds when non-nil; corresponding DelayMin/DelaySecondsMin and DelayMax/DelaySecondsMax pairs follow same rule. Defaults0. Native Float conversion accepts numbers, numeric strings, C-locale strtof string prefixes, otherwise default0.
admission.condition: Queue when baseDelay>0 OR minimum>0 OR maximum>0; otherwise immediate action.
admission.randomization: Only baseDelay>0 AND maximum>minimum triggers original Deterministic::RandomFloat(min,max). Range-only positive minimum/maximum does not sample; unchanged base (often0) still queues.
admission.arguments: ScriptArgs.mTable is copied with lua_rawgeti/luaL_ref; actual original Lua table remains aliased. Copying parsed native name/ID caches is separate; admission has not populated those target caches. Do not deep-copy the Lua table.

execution.condition: Strict float worldTime > deadline; equality remains pending.
execution.phase: Native ScriptManager::Update before calling original Lua Main.update.
execution.queues: Existing TO_FIRE records followed by new ACTION_TO_ADD admissions; not-due records and admissions made during execution survive in order for a subsequent pump. They are not recursively executed in the admitting pump.
execution.clear: Native ScriptManager::Clear destroys both action queues and resets HAS_CRASHED, alongside broader callback/cache cleanup. Portable clear covers its action queues/fault only; parent owns remaining lifecycle.

portable.api: initializeDelayedActions with explicit verified native Void whitelist; admitDelayedAction returns ExecuteNow/Queued; advanceDelayedActions invokes genuine parent immediate executor; clearDelayedActions performs full cancellation; snapshot/dump diagnostics.
portable.argument_lifetime: VM-owned registry tables retain actual source args table until execution/cancellation; no host file/game data mutation.
portable.random: Required parent callback into recovered deterministic stream. Missing provider on the actual sampled branch fails explicitly.
portable.errors: Unsupported actions/return kinds fail at admission. Failed delivery retains interrupted/remaining records and a fault, preventing silent retries. Explicit clear releases records and fault. Parent executor must protect Lua calls and preserve borrowed stack.
portable.bounds: Nonfinite clock/delay/RNG/deadline rejected explicitly. Cancellation during execution and reentrant pumping rejected until native lifecycle behavior is recovered.
portable.validation: ASan/UBSan pass: strict float deadlines, FIFO, original-table mutation visibility, captured deadline, next-pump admissions, range-only quirk, required RNG, native string prefix conversion, unsupported IDs, failed-record retention, cancellation and reference release.

notify_frame.condition: CheckFramePassed RVA0x27e0e0 resolves active target Things via Names/Ids; returns true if ANY selected Thing.pAnimation(+0x138)->frame(+0x80) >= integer Frame(default0). Empty target set false. This is animation frame, not World.mFrame.
notify_frame.limits: Condition admission, timeout and event delivery driver require further recovery; portable queue does not fabricate animation state or condition completion.

limits: Static original code/source and portable component validation only; no full engine/native gameplay completion.
Individual task cancellation is not invented; recovered cancellation is full ScriptManager::Clear boundary.
Full native notify registration/timeout dispatch and all engine action bodies remain separate.
